name: Patio Sling Folding Chair (black)
material: 2*1 tesilin fabrics w/t steel frame powder coated
description: The steel powder coated frame makes a sturdy and tough design, forming a core that will provide years of reliable use. A pillow is included for you to rest and support your head and neck. Adjustable backrests can be set to five different levels, allowing you to rest back to a position that is best for you. Textilene seat evenly distributes your weight when seated, allowing you to relax comfortably over longer periods of time. Being foldable makes it easy to pick up, store away and keep in the boot of your car  ideal for taking away for day trips.
